section.title: 读代码：关键改动
section.md: 下面这个提交把采样从多步 ODE 改成了一步欧拉，是「30 FPS」的直接来源（红色是删除，绿色是新增）：

code-block.caption: sampler.py：从 50 步 ODE 到一步欧拉

section.code-block: @torch.no_grad() def sample(self, cond, steps=None): x = torch.randn(cond.shape[0], *self.shape, device=cond.device) - ts = torch.linspace(0, 1, steps or 50, device=cond.device) - for t0, t1 in zip(ts[:-1], ts[1:]): - v = self.net(x, t0.expand(x.shape[0]), cond) - x = x + (t1 - t0) * v + t = torch.zeros(x.shape[0], device=cond.device) + x = x + self.net(x, t, cond) # one Euler step is enough for near-straight paths return x

tab.title: 训练损失
tab.code-block: def flow_matching_loss(net, x1, cond): x0 = torch.randn_like(x1) t = torch.rand(x1.shape[0], device=x1.device) xt = (1 - t[:, None, None, None]) * x0 + t[:, None, None, None] * x1 target = x1 - x0 pred = net(xt, t, cond) return F.mse_loss(pred, target) # [!code highlight]
